findings.evidence: Mathlib/GroupTheory/QuotientGroup/Basic.lean:98 defines `QuotientGroup.kerLift`, and line 106 proves `kerLift_injective`; the PR instead performs quotient representatives and equality calculations at lines 68–74.
findings.fix: Rewrite `N.comap f` as the kernel of `(QuotientGroup.mk' N).comp f` using `QuotientGroup.ker_mk'` and `MonoidHom.comap_ker`, then apply `hN.of_injective (QuotientGroup.kerLift _) (QuotientGroup.kerLift_injective _)`.
findings.issue: `IsPGroup.quotient_comap` manually proves injectivity of the quotient map, duplicating `QuotientGroup.kerLift_injective`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/GroupTheory/QuotientGroup/Defs.lean:272 provides `lift_surjective_of_surjective`; lines 261–265 of the PR reproduce its representative argument.
findings.fix: Prove `(QuotientGroup.mk' M.toSubgroup).comp π` surjective by composing the two existing `mk'_surjective` results, then pass it to `QuotientGroup.lift_surjective_of_surjective`.
findings.issue: The surjectivity proof for the lifted homomorphism manually lifts representatives through two quotient maps, duplicating `QuotientGroup.lift_surjective_of_surjective`.

summary: Two quotient-map injectivity/surjectivity arguments rederive existing Mathlib plumbing.
